source: Requirement IDs and paraphrased summaries from the client's requirements list: user stories US-001 to US-066 and business rules BR-001 to BR-029.

requirements.summary: Finance can add a new initiative without rebuilding the system
Finance can attach required reports to an initiative
Questions are maintained centrally, not rebuilt per form
requirements.note: Standard questions come from one shared library in the application. Each form version stores its own copy, so a published form never changes underneath a report.

requirements.summary: Standard questions are shared and initiative questions are specific
Field types cover performance, financial, budget and narrative data
Follow-up questions appear only when an answer calls for them
A question can contain a table to complete
Drop-down answers are limited to valid choices
Copy the prior fiscal year's structure into a new year
requirements.note: The fiscal year rollover copies forms and assignments into the new year. Finance administrators run it.

requirements.summary: Questions and layouts carry forward automatically
Rename, combine or retire initiatives and reports
requirements.note: Rollover can rename or retire an initiative, and combine several initiatives into one with lineage links.

requirements.summary: History stays linked when initiatives change
requirements.note: Lineage links connect predecessor and successor initiatives. Each submission keeps the form version it was created on.

requirements.summary: Each person has their own account
Organizations see only the reports assigned to them
Organizations see their full history, including colleagues' reports
Start a required report
Save partway and return later
Work in progress saves automatically
Submit a completed report
The submitter receives an email copy of what was submitted
Print or save a submitted report as PDF
Upload several supporting documents
Excel, Word, CSV and PDF files are accepted
Files up to 25 MB are accepted
Budgets are entered in a spreadsheet-style grid
Totals calculate as you type
Finance sets fields that must add up to a required value
A report cannot be submitted until required totals match
Fields enforce number, currency, percent and other types
Fields enforce length limits such as EIN digits and word counts
Missing required fields are identified before submission
Unbalanced budgets and other errors are caught before submission
EIN and organization details are checked against the master list
Organization details fill in automatically
Error messages say exactly what to fix
Finance administers its own users
Access levels include view-only
Finance can trigger password resets
One central dashboard of submissions
Outstanding, missing and incomplete reports are identified
Submissions filter across many fields
A flagged items view gathers problems for review
Finance can flag a submission
Finance can request updates and the organization resubmits
Authorized staff can correct submitted data with an audit record
Export submitted data to Excel
Export submitted data to CSV
Build queries from selected criteria
Generate charts
Generate graphs of trends and comparisons
Dashboard visualizations
Automated reminder emails to organizations
requirements.note: Reminder rules queue one email per organization per rule per day and skip reports already submitted.

requirements.summary: Hosted outside Council-owned servers
requirements.note: Delivery commitment confirmed when the production environment is built. The proposed target is Azure Government.

requirements.summary: Cloud hosting meets FedRAMP or NIST 800-53
requirements.note: Confirmed in the security review before go-live. Application controls in place: row-level security, append-only audit tables, server-side validation.

requirements.summary: The Council owns all system data
requirements.note: Contractual commitment. Full Excel and CSV export is available to Finance staff (see US-046 and US-047).

requirements.summary: Submitted data is kept permanently
requirements.note: No application role can delete submissions, submitted revisions or audit events.

requirements.summary: Audit trails and change history
The Council is told about any breach
requirements.note: Procedural commitment: the incident response plan and notification terms are agreed in the contract.

requirements.summary: No limit on submitting users
requirements.note: Accounts are database records; the application sets no limit on the number of submitting users.

requirements.summary: 50 to 100 Finance users with different permissions
Vendor help with account issues
requirements.note: Support model described on the Platform page. Operational commitment.

requirements.summary: Post-launch support, monitoring and maintenance
requirements.note: Support model described on the Platform page. Operational commitment.

requirements.summary: Support requests answered quickly, preferably within 24 hours
requirements.note: Support model described on the Platform page. Operational commitment.

requirements.summary: Annual review of reporting structure with Finance
requirements.note: Annual changes are made as form drafts and rollover, not code changes. The review itself is a scheduled engagement with Finance.

requirements.summary: Formal testing period before go-live
requirements.note: Testing period is part of the delivery timeline on the Platform page.

requirements.summary: Formal training period before go-live
requirements.note: Training period is part of the delivery timeline on the Platform page.

requirements.summary: About 175 initiatives, changing each year
Each initiative reports at least twice a year
requirements.note: Each fiscal year has a mid-year and a year-end reporting period.

requirements.summary: Reports combine performance, financial and narrative content
Forms mix common and initiative-specific questions
An initiative can fund one or more than 100 organizations
One report per initiative, even for multi-initiative organizations
Several people at one organization may submit
Budgets can have up to 100 lines
The EIN determines which reports an organization owes
Organizations can open only their assigned reports
Sign-in is per person, never a shared login
Uploads are limited to 25 MB per file
Work can be paused and resumed
Submission triggers an email with the submitted content
Questions and layouts carry into the next fiscal year
Renamed or combined initiatives keep their history
requirements.note: Lineage links and pinned form versions keep history when initiatives are renamed or combined.

requirements.summary: 50 to 100 Finance users with varied permissions
Unlimited submitting users
requirements.note: Accounts are database records; the application sets no limit on the number of submitting users.

requirements.summary: Submitted data is kept permanently
The Council owns the data
requirements.note: Contractual commitment. Full export is available to Finance staff.

requirements.summary: Required fields must be complete before submission
Totals must equal the required amount before submission
EIN and organization details match the master list
Organization details fill in where possible
Breaches are reported with a remediation plan
requirements.note: Procedural commitment agreed in the contract.

requirements.summary: Hosted in a compliant cloud, not on Council servers
requirements.note: Delivery commitment confirmed when the production environment is built.

requirements.summary: Target go-live February 1, 2027
requirements.note: Target date in the delivery timeline on the Platform page.

requirements.summary: Annual structure review with Finance
requirements.note: Scheduled engagement with Finance. Structure changes are configuration, not code.

requirements.summary: Fast post-launch support response
requirements.note: Support model described on the Platform page. Operational commitment.
